# Run summary (auto-generated by analysis/analyze_ppo.py)

All numbers come from the run artifacts: `evaluations.npz` (during-training eval,
10 episodes/point) and `final_eval_results.json` (20 deterministic episodes on the
best checkpoint, seed-2024 env). Reward is the raw environment reward.

## Learning-rate comparison (1024-rollout runs only)

- **Ant**: lr 1e-4 reached 3095 vs 1771 for lr 3e-4 (+1323 in favour of lr 1e-4).
- **Humanoid**: lr 1e-4 reached 5783 vs 1014 for lr 3e-4 (+4769 in favour of lr 1e-4).

## Seed robustness (Humanoid, lr 1e-4)

- Best eval across seeds: 5687 – 5783 (2% spread) — single-seed results should be read cautiously.

## Rollout-length ablation (Ant, lr 3e-4)

- 2048: best eval 3018, eval@1M 571, sample-efficiency score 0.37
- 1024: best eval 1771, eval@1M 1085, sample-efficiency score 0.54
